title: 稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路案例中比較輸入與專家張量與top-k門控route，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate inputs and expert tensors and top-k gated routing within the Sparse mixture-of-experts network case.

steps.title: 閘控與稀疏專家：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Gating and sparse experts: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對輸入與專家張量提出可反駁的閘控與稀疏專家模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable gating and sparse experts model and evidence record for inputs and expert tensors.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識輸入與專家張量。router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。 建立閘控與稀疏專家的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify inputs and expert tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of gating and sparse experts, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。
steps.observationEn: List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有模型參數都會在每個token上同時啟動。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every model parameter activates on every token.
steps.check: 提交輸入與專家張量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for inputs and expert tensors.

knowledge.title: 閘控與稀疏專家
knowledge.text: router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。 本課架構對應：輸入與專家張量
knowledge.textEn: Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ. Course architecture correspondence: Inputs and expert tensors

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有模型參數都會在每個token上同時啟動。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every model parameter activates on every token.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(64×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=196608 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=26624 byte，算術強度=7.3846 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(64x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 196608 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 26624 bytes, intensity 7.3846 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.

quiz.question: 就輸入與專家張量的「閘控與稀疏專家」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for gating and sparse experts in inputs and expert tensors?
options: router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。
所有模型參數都會在每個token上同時啟動。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ.
Every model parameter activates on every token.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。 對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。
quiz.explanationEn: Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ. List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing.

steps.title: 閘控與稀疏專家：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Gating and sparse experts: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對輸入與專家張量提出可反駁的閘控與稀疏專家模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable gating and sparse experts model and evidence record for inputs and expert tensors.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「閘控與稀疏專家」模型，檢查輸入與專家張量的兩個假想案例。對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous gating and sparse experts model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving inputs and expert tensors. List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。
steps.observationEn: List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有模型參數都會在每個token上同時啟動。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every model parameter activates on every token.
steps.check: 提交輸入與專家張量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for inputs and expert tensors.

steps.title: 容量與路由負載：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Capacity and routing load: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對top-k門控route提出可反駁的容量與路由負載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable capacity and routing load model and evidence record for top-k gated routing.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識top-k門控route。專家容量限制可能丟棄或重路由token；相同平均負載不表示無局部overflow。 建立容量與路由負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify top-k gated routing in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Expert capacity can drop/reroute tokens; equal mean load does not imply no local overflow. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of capacity and routing load, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。
steps.observationEn: Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：平均token量低於容量就排除所有專家超載。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Mean token load below capacity rules out every expert overload.
steps.check: 提交top-k門控route的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for top-k gated routing.

steps.title: 專家資料搬運：架構分析
steps.objective: 針對稀疏梯度路徑提出可反駁的專家資料搬運模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable expert data movement model and evidence record for sparse gradient paths.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識稀疏梯度路徑。分散專家需搬運token與輸出；all-to-all通信會影響端到端成本及負載平衡。 建立專家資料搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定token數比較本地與跨裝置專家路由bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify sparse gradient paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Distributed experts move tokens/results; all-to-all traffic affects cost/load balance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of expert data movement, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare local/cross-device routing bytes at fixed token count. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.observationEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：高confidence就足以認定答案正確。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.
steps.check: 提交專家負載與overflow的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for expert load and overflow.

knowledge.title: 失效分析與泛化
knowledge.text: 平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 本課架構對應：專家負載與overflow
knowledge.textEn: Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Course architecture correspondence: Expert load and overflow

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；高confidence就足以認定答案正確。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(64×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=196608 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=26624 byte，算術強度=7.3846 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(64x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 196608 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 26624 bytes, intensity 7.3846 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.

quiz.question: 就專家負載與overflow的「失效分析與泛化」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for failure analysis and generalization in expert load and overflow?
options: 高confidence就足以認定答案正確。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
optionsEn: High confidence establishes correctness.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.
quiz.explanation: 平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
quiz.explanationEn: Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.

summaryEn: Explore Sparse mixture-of-experts network through gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

workedExample.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(64×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=196608 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=26624 byte，算術強度=7.3846 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
workedExample.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(64x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 196608 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 26624 bytes, intensity 7.3846 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
